title: Protocol to characterize Gi/o and Gs protein-coupled receptors in transiently transfected cells using ELISA and cAMP measurements
protocol: Harvest the cells from the cell culture flask.
Remove the medium.
Wash the cells once with sterile D-PBS.
Add trypsin-EDTA to cover the surface and incubate at room temperature for 2–5 minutes.
Stop trypsinization by adding growth medium to the flask.
Resuspend the cells and transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL tube.
Count cells and check viability.
Seed cells in 25 cm² flasks: 0.9 × 10⁶ cells for CHO-K1 and 1.6 × 10⁶ for HEK293-T.
Incubate the seeded cells in a humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C overnight (∼16 h).
Transfect cells in 25 cm² cell culture flasks to ensure homogeneous transfection efficiency.
Include an empty vector as a reference during transfection.
Ensure cells are 70%–80% confluent on the day of transfection.
Add 3 μg (CHO-K1) or 4 μg (HEK293-T) of plasmid DNA to a final volume of 500 μL Opti-MEM, mix well by inverting.
Prepare Lipofectamine 2000 dilution by adding 10 μL Lipofectamine 2000 to 500 μL Opti-MEM per transfected flask, mix by inverting 3–4 times and incubate at RT for 3–5 min.
Add the mixture of Opti-MEM and Lipofectamine 2000 to the tube containing Opti-MEM and plasmid DNA, mix by inverting 3–4 times.
Incubate the transfection mix at RT for 20 min.
Aspirate the medium from the 25 cm² flask cell culture flasks.
Add 1 mL Opti-MEM per 25 cm² flask.
Add the transfection mix and incubate at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for 4-6 hours.
After the incubation, add 3 mL of growth medium per 25 cm² flask.
Leave the cells in a humidified CO₂ (5%) incubator at 37°C overnight (∼16 h).
Harvest the cells from the 25 cm² flasks.

Seed the harvested cells in different plates depending on the assay: for cAMP measurements, seed in 96-well plates; for GPCR plasma membrane expression analyses, seed in 48-well plates; for sandwich ELISA to determine total expression levels of the receptor, seed in 6-well plates.
Check cell viability in the 25 cm² flask under the microscope.
Coat plates with Poly-L-lysine at a dilution of 1:50 in D-PBS for at least 30 minutes at 37°C.
Aspirate the Poly-L-lysine solution from the coated plates.
Remove the medium from the cell culture flask.
Wash the cells once with sterile D-PBS.
Add 1 mL of Versene per 25 cm² flask and gently move the flask to rinse the entire area.
Immediately remove Versene after rinsing.
Incubate the flasks for 2-5 minutes at room temperature to allow cell detachment.
Harvest cells by adding respective growth medium to the 25 cm² flasks.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL tube.
Count the cells using the established method in your lab.
Prepare a master mix for seeding the cells in growth medium.
Seed the cells in a total volume of 200 μL/w in 96-well plates.
Seed the cells in a total volume of 500 μL/w in 48-well plates.
Seed the cells in a total volume of 1 mL/w in 6-well plates.
Incubate the seeded 96-well plates in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C for approximately 6 hours.
Incubate the 6-well plates and 48-well plates in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C until the following day.
Do not exchange the medium for cells seeded for ELISA analyses.
Remove the growth medium from cells for cAMP measurements.
Replace it with respective serum-free cell culture medium.
Starve cells overnight for 16 h at 37°C in a humidified incubator (5% CO2).
Do not change the medium of cells seeded for relative expression analyses.
Allow cells to attach to the plate for at least 5 hours before changing the medium to serum-free.
Aspirate the medium from the cells.
Add 500 μL of 4% formaldehyde in PBS per well and fix the cells under light orbital shaking for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells twice with 500 μL of PBS per well.
Dry the wells by tapping the inverted plate on a paper towel.
Block the wells by adding 500 μL of cell culture medium containing 10% FBS and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C under light orbital shaking.

Remove the blocking medium and add 100 μL of the Anti-HA-peroxidase antibody solution diluted 1:1000 in cell culture medium with 10% FBS per well. Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature under light orbital shaking.
Wash cells three times with 500 μL of PBS per well for 5 minutes each under moderate orbital shaking.
Remove all residual PBS and ensure that the wells are dry.

Prepare the detection solutions (starting solution and stopping reagent). The starting reagent contains 10 mg o-phenylenediamine, 25 mL substrate buffer, and 40 μL H₂O₂. Add H₂O₂ just before starting the detection.
Dilute Na₂SO₃ in 1 M HCl to make the stopping reagent.
Add 200 μL of starting solution per well and incubate at room temperature for 2–20 minutes under moderate shaking.
Stop the reaction by adding 100 μL of stopping reagent per well.
Transfer 200 μL from each well to a non-sterile 96-well plate.
Measure absorbance in absorbance units (measurement wavelength: 492 nm, reference wavelength: 620 nm) using a suitable plate reader.
Prepare HBSS/HEPES with 1 mM IBMX.
For Gαi/o-coupled receptors, add 2 μM forskolin to the HBSS/HEPES + IBMX.
Remove medium from cells.
Add 50 μl of HBSS/HEPES + IBMX per well and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard HBSS/HEPES + IBMX from plates.
Add 50 μL of ligand dilutions in HBSS/HEPES + IBMX or HBSS/HEPES + IBMX + forskolin per well.
Incubate plates at 37°C for 15 min.
Place plates on ice and gently aspirate medium twice.
Add 50 μL of LI buffer per well.
Freeze plates at −20°C for at least 30 min or overnight.
Remove the medium from the 6-well plate.
Harvest cells using a cell scraper.
Option: Freeze the plates at this step (−20°C).
Resuspend cells by pipetting up and down if frozen.
Transfer the H2O/cell suspension to a 2 mL tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at top speed at RT.
Discard supernatant using a pipette.
Gently resuspend the cell pellet in 150 μL lysis buffer using a pipette.
Solubilize for 1 h at RT and then overnight at 4°C under light shaking.
Coat 96-well Maxi-Sorp plate with Anti-FLAG-M2 monoclonal antibody at a concentration of 10 μg/mL in coating buffer.
Add 100 μL/w of the Anti-FLAG-M2 antibody solution to each well.
Shake the coated plate for 1 hour at room temperature (RT).
Incubate the coated plate overnight at 4°C.
Aspirate the Anti-FLAG-M2 antibody dilution from the 96-well Maxi-Sorp plate.
Wash the plate 3 times for 5 minutes with PBS-T at RT, tapping dry between washing cycles.
Block the plate with 200 μL of cell culture medium containing 10% FBS for 1 hour at 37°C under light orbital shaking (0.16 rcf).
Remove the blocking solution from the plate.
Repeat step 6 to wash the plate again.
Centrifuge solubilized cells for 10 minutes at top speed (minimum 13,000 rcf) at RT.
Transfer approximately 130 μL of supernatant to a new tube and add 300 μL PBS-T.
Discard the pellet.
Transfer 100 μL of the diluted supernatant to each well in triplicate on the 96-well Maxi-Sorp plate.
Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37°C under light shaking (0.16 rcf) to enable adsorption of FLAG-tagged receptor protein to the immobilized Anti-FLAG antibody.
Remove the supernatant from the plate.
Dilute the antibody (Anti-HA-peroxidase) 1:1000 to a final concentration of 50 mU/mL in PBS-T.
Add 100 μL per well and fill surrounding wells with liquid.
Incubate under light shaking (0.16 rcf) for 1 h at RT.
Remove the antibody solution from the plate.
Repeat step 33.
Use 150 μL of starting reagent and 50 μL stopping reagent per well.
Measure absorbance in a suitable plate reader with measurement wavelength: 492 nm, reference wavelength: 620 nm.
Thaw the 96-well plates from step 29f while shaking them moderately (approximately 0.3 rcf) on an orbital shaker for 30 min at RT to homogenously lyse cells and distribute cAMP in LI buffer.
Prepare the cAMP standard curve as described in the protocol provided by the manufacturer.
Freeze the cAMP standard curve and store it at -20°C.
Calculate for 10% more points for acceptor and donor bead solutions.
Seal and spin down the 384-well plate briefly, not faster than 400 rcf.
Transfer 5 μl lysate from each well of the 96-well plate to a 384-well Opti-Plate using a 12-channel transfer pipette.
Add triplicates of each concentration of the standard curve.
Seal and spin down the plate, not faster than 400 rcf.
Work in a dark room with only dim green light for the assay.
Measure the 384-well plate using a plate reader able to detect AlphaScreen technology (excitation 680 nm; emission 520–620 nm).
